label: final two copy-phase outputs (end of copy)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original inputs or <DEL>, and only on inputs that are repeats (in_first=0). About 82% of activation mass and 73% of active steps are on the last two copy steps (to_go 0 or 1). It almost never fires more than 5 steps from the end. Magnitude is largest for short sequences: L=3 at recall_idx 2 (the final output, two steps after <DEL>) gives the top activations, and L=3/4 have rate 33%/12% versus about 4% for longer L. Precision is low (about 24%): within the final two steps it fires more often for some echoed input tokens (g, p, i, n, u, 2, 3) and less for others, and no simple token rule fixes this. Adding those tokens or L<=4 raises dev F1 only to about 0.49. The rest of the activations are weak, on steps 2 to 5 before the end.
